conditions.runtime: ServerLogin 1.0.3 dedicated chat adapter, Economy enabled for native merchant prices
conditions.acceptance: Production packaging and local native installation, player acceptance pending

change.summary: Skip ServerLogin local-chat dispatch for ordinary authenticated chat, and pay at least one Copper for a positively priced complete villager sale

modifiers.before: ServerLogin routes OP2 ordinary messages to same-dimension radius chat. Prior local adapter canceled inside the manager method
modifiers.after: Exact LoginEvents.onChat call-site redirect does not invoke AdminChatManager.handleDefaultChat, native public player-chat continues for every authenticated sender including OP. Authentication input and explicit commands retain their own owners

modifiers.before: A positive fractional native sale can quote a zero whole-Copper payout and its renderer draws no price

unchanged: Global Market and Shipping Box fractional prices
Native stock, counts, NBT and restocking
Funded NPC_MARKET settlement and existing fractional claims

cause.owner: JEMCompat chat adapter and JEMEconomy native merchant pricing

rationale.purpose: Ordinary messages reach public chat and villagers no longer offer a blank payout for positively priced small sales
rationale.decision_source: User 2026-10-26 explicitly removes ServerLogin local dispatch even for OP, then replaces the earlier hide-offers request with one Copper for these villager trades
rationale.implementation: Skip the one exact admin/local call after authentication checks and share one transaction-price minimum between quote and actual funded sale

introduced.summary: Public chat call-site exclusion and minimum one-Copper native sale

history.summary: Latest user correction retains small positively priced villager offers with one-Copper minimum instead of removing them. Shader work explicitly excluded

notes: No new offer list, no prices for unknown goods and no renderer error placeholder
